verdicts.explanation: These six pages return a real 200 response but the raw HTML has no body text at all, only the Next.js mount point; nothing in their content marks them as test, error or placeholder pages.

The homepage states the brand's identity only in prose (its meta description calls it a specialty coffee roaster); no page in the crawl carries Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with sameAs to anchor that identity.
The same six URLs already appear in B4_empty_shell: they return no HTML content at all, so their missing title tag is a symptom of that empty shell, not a separate defect.

fixes.quote: This fall, we invite you to celebrate the art of slow living in every cup.
site_specific: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage naming "Blue Bottle Coffee" with a sameAs array pointing at the brand's own verified social and reference profiles.
Reuse the same Organization block (or a matching Brand reference) on /us/eng/our-story so the two pages state the same identity.

fixes.quote: Discover coffees, brew tools, and drinkware thoughtfully crafted to renew your daily rituals.
site_specific: Publish an XML sitemap listing the homepage, /us/eng/subscriptions, /us/eng/our-story, /us/eng/brew-guides and the product pages, and declare it in robots.txt.
Regenerate the sitemap whenever a product or brew guide page is added or removed.

fixes.quote: Our story is a reflection of our roots, our obsession with exceptional coffee, and the unique people and spaces that bring the Blue Bottle ritual to life.
site_specific: Wrap this page's history and mission text in AboutPage or Organization JSON-LD so the story quoted here is machine-readable, not only prose.
